walkthrough:
Calculate the area of quadrilateral $OATB$ and sector $AOB$:
$$\text{Area}(OATB) = 2 \times \left(\frac{1}{2} r \times r\tan\theta\right) = r^2\tan\theta$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } AOB) = \frac{1}{2}r^2(2\theta) = r^2\theta$$

Express the shaded area as the difference between the kite and sector areas:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}(OATB) - \text{Area}(\text{sector } AOB) = r^2\tan\theta - r^2\theta$$

Equate the sector area to the shaded area:
$$r^2\theta = r^2\tan\theta - r^2\theta \implies 2r^2\theta = r^2\tan\theta \implies \tan\theta = 2\theta$$

Determine the angle $\theta$ from the given arc length:
$$\text{Arc } AB = r(2\theta) \implies 19.2 = 8(2\theta) \implies 16\theta = 19.2 \implies \theta = 1.2 \text{ radians}$$

Calculate the area of the kite $OATB$ and sector $AOB$:
$$\text{Area}(OATB) = r^2\tan\theta = 8^2\tan(1.2) = 64\tan(1.2) \approx 164.618 \text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } AOB) = \frac{1}{2}r^2(2\theta) = \frac{1}{2}(64)(2.4) = 76.8 \text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the sector area from the kite area (to 3 significant figures):
$$\text{Shaded Area} = 164.618 - 76.8 = 87.818 \approx 87.8 \text{ cm}^2$$
